Urticaria. Oral antihistamines are the main drugs used in the management of urticaria (p.1584). Addition of a calcium-chan- nel blocker, such as nifedipine, has been suggested for patients unresponsive to treatment with oral antihistamines alone, but re- sults have been mixed.1,2 1.
